text: One more reading before I pack. The funnel is above the Choir. Put the current through it, would you? My measuring ribbon is tied to its rim. Please leave it tied.
speaker: Cartographer

text: The pale intake is on the Choir’s lower shelf. Put your mouth there; the funnel holds the other end. A steady stream, please.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Every instrument says the wind stops at the canyon. The trees on the other side disagree. I have been calling that interference.
speaker: Cartographer

text: That interval should not exist on this chart. It exists in the trees. Help me get this desk outside.
speaker: Cartographer

text: The chart can wait. I would like to hear the sea.
speaker: Cartographer

text: I have drawn that coastline eleven times. Never stood on it. Leave the ribbon there; it tells me when to listen. The chart can wait.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Still listening. Not taking a reading.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Take the survey kite. It knows the way down this canyon better than I do.
speaker: Cartographer

text: I’ll take the reading.
speaker: The Knight

text: The lower slate takes the current. The mouth at the funnel is fixed. Give it a moment to fill.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Oh. My ribbon. Follow it, please. It stops fighting the wind between gusts.
speaker: Cartographer

text: It beats differently out there. Put your mouth at the funnel now; the chimes hold the far end. Ring them when the ribbon shines.
speaker: Cartographer

text: My ribbon has blown into the channel above the Choir. Ride the drafts after it; it catches on things between gusts.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Take it to the upper funnel. Hold it steady when the wind slackens.
speaker: Cartographer

text: Bring that reading to the chimes over my desk. Strike them on the ribbon’s bright beat.
speaker: Cartographer

text: I can make the crossing. I can. My uncle’s helmet is on the sniper’s shelf, beyond those moving shields. Could you fetch it? Then we could go together.
speaker: Recruit

text: The high shelf, over the two moving shields. I’ll wait on this side. Right here.
speaker: Recruit

text: Three campaigns, he wore it. I decided that meant something. I know it is only a helmet. I would still like it back.
speaker: Recruit

text: Still afraid. Made it anyway. I think those can both be true.
speaker: Recruit

text: Keep the helmet on the post. It is doing something useful there.
speaker: Recruit

text: I kept thinking the fear would stop first. It didn’t. But I heard your feet, and I could move mine. Keep the helmet on the post. I’ll take the watch from here.
speaker: Recruit

text: I can see the next volley from here. Wait for the flash, then go.
speaker: Recruit

text: I re-strung the ballistas. A bolt will carry you back over the hollow. Hold on to the fletching.
speaker: Recruit

text: I’ll get it. Then we’ll cross together.
speaker: The Knight

text: The shelf over the shields. It should still be up there.
speaker: Recruit

text: There’s a hole clean through it. Well. Stay close. I can walk as fast as you; stop when the warning lights.
speaker: Recruit

text: Put it on that catch by the floor slate. Give it a tap with your blade. Let a shot ring against it, then we go together.
speaker: Recruit

text: My helmet is up the side tower. Fetch it, and I will try the crossing with you.
speaker: Recruit

text: Bring it back. I am by the brass release.
speaker: Recruit

text: There is a hole through it. We will wait for a volley, then cross together. Keep moving when it is clear.
speaker: Recruit

text: I finish one, he smashes it. Every time.
speaker: Maker

text: I scrap it.
speaker: Breaker

text: Put a mark on the loose piece at the intake. Follow it. Tell us which counter is lying.
speaker: Maker

text: The pale intake, west down the line. Blade makes a good mark. Hands clear of the stamp.
speaker: Breaker

text: The supervisor said keep the line moving.
speaker: Maker

text: The supervisor left months ago.
speaker: Breaker

text: The instructions didn’t.
speaker: Maker

text: Green. Same piece, counted twice.
speaker: Breaker

text: I brought lunch for two.
speaker: Maker

text: Good.
speaker: Breaker

text: Right. Sit down.
speaker: Maker

text: Still green. She saved you a seat.
speaker: Breaker

text: One cart and a forge seal, off the books. The counters can count themselves.
speaker: Maker

text: I’ll mark one and follow it.
speaker: The Knight

text: The loose one at the intake. Give it a mark we can both see.
speaker: Maker

text: Into the pale intake, out of the return mouth. Keep your fingers away from the stamp.
speaker: Breaker

text: That is the same mark. It came back.
speaker: Maker

text: Catch it at the return. I’ll hold the chute. Bring it to the cradle and hold the catch.
speaker: Breaker

text: Put a mark on the piece moving up the chute. Catch it where the first counter passes it on.
speaker: Maker

text: Lift that marked piece through the cooling loft. Drop it and it comes back to the last safe catch.
speaker: Maker

text: Same mark. Feed it to our side counter and hold the catch for one complete stamp.
speaker: Maker

text: I invited her for tea.
speaker: Wendell

text: And I explained about the floor. Our caddy has rolled onto the courtyard shelf. Catch it before it goes over.
speaker: Ottilie

text: Turn the room before it reaches the edge. Down is a matter of opinion here.
speaker: Ottilie

text: We met on the middle landing before it fell.
speaker: Wendell

text: Last time I went over, he wore the tea.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I caught the pot.
speaker: Wendell

text: With your lap.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I did, dear. Pass the biscuits.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I still try to catch her spoons.
speaker: Wendell

text: He does. It is quite sweet, from this way up.
speaker: Ottilie

text: The tea gets here the right way up. From my side.
speaker: Ottilie

text: Through our joined tables, dear. The ceiling is one long corridor when you know where to step.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I’ll catch the caddy first.
speaker: The Knight

text: Over the courtyard shelf. Turn the room to catch it before it rolls off.
speaker: Ottilie

text: Park the pot in the recess first. A tap with the flat of your blade. Then turn over for the cups.
speaker: Wendell

text: Now the two pale surfaces. Link them and slide the closed pot through.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I will catch my end.
speaker: Wendell

text: The caddy is rolling on the shelf up the chimney. Turn the room and catch it.
speaker: Wendell

text: Park the pot in the service recess before turning over for the cups. A tap with your blade will set it down.
speaker: Wendell

text: Bring both back to our landing. We will tip the tray between us while you cross the room the way you came.
speaker: Wendell

text: My father’s brass charm is flashing up in the rigging. I thought I lost it. If you are going aloft, follow the flashes.
speaker: Hallam

text: Your hook will reach the hanging rings. Mind the loose line above the deck.
speaker: Hallam

text: He carried it every voyage. I am not saying it holds the ship together. I would just like it back.
speaker: Hallam

text: Half each. Both hands for the rope.
speaker: Hallam

text: So far.
speaker: Stranded sailor

text: Father said never give it away. He did not say anything about half.
speaker: Hallam

text: Mine is working.
speaker: Stranded sailor

text: So is mine. Sit down before your legs find out.
speaker: Hallam

text: Take the storm sail. It runs along the line before any wind, and it will bring you home.
speaker: Hallam

text: I’ll follow the flashes.
speaker: The Knight

text: The harbour rings, once the chain gate is clear. Jump toward the next flash before hooking again. The flashing bit is caught on something.
speaker: Hallam

text: There is someone on that line. Hold your hook. I have the lower end.
speaker: Hallam

text: It is tied into his safety line. Bring him down first. We can split it at the cleat.
speaker: Hallam

text: My father’s charm is up the rigging. Follow it on the hooks; it pauses where you can reach it.
speaker: Hallam

text: Someone is tied to it. Hold the line at the upper hook while I take the strain below.
speaker: Hallam

text: Bring the sailor back down to our deck. Stay close; we will split the charm at the cleat.
speaker: Hallam

text: Mark the piece, then follow it. Hands clear of the stamp.
speaker: Breaker

text: Same white mark. I will hold the chute while you work the catch.
speaker: Breaker

text: Park the pot before turning. His down is not my down.
speaker: Ottilie

text: I have this end. Tip the tray gently.
speaker: Ottilie
